title: How Google’s new Pixel 11 phones compare to last year’s models
summary: Google just added four new phones to the Pixel family: the Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL, and the Pixel 11 Pro Fold. The Pro can also zoom up to 120x and features a 42-megapixel selfie camera.
